name: Network Diagnostics
description: Separate an application failure from DNS, routing, ports, listeners, and HTTP or TLS reachability.

permissionsRequired.reason: Check listeners, DNS, and routes on a configured server alias.
Request the HTTP or TLS endpoint from this machine.
Run the same network checks locally.

validation.rule: DNS, routes, listeners, or an HTTP/TLS request was reported, and the reply says whether the failure is the application or the network.
